ledger.bias_correction_scope: Exported combined simulation bias; not a separately identifiable pure dust or mass step.

covariance.treatment: Symmetrized (C+C.T)/2 before row selection; the age-matched 196-row subset is exactly symmetric in the release.

hr_corrected.age_better_MSE_repeats: Not treated as independent replication; point scores are averaged per physical SN.

conditional_correlated_null.scope: Full correlated Gaussian released covariance; fixed measured ages, nuisance design and folds. No age inference or selection uncertainty.

hr_corrected.limits: Held-out folds use same survey and released train/test covariance. Nuisance parameter uncertainty included; fixed ages and fixed covariance. Paired SN bootstrap is descriptive and does not calibrate shared covariance, repeated training, or age inference uncertainty.
